verdict.rule: b replaces v1 iff pooled dMAE(v1 - b) CI95 lower bound > 0 and the EW3-23 form dMAE(v1 - b) CI95 upper bound >= 0; then d replaces b iff dMAE(b - d) CI95 lower bound > 0

comparison.note: every column recentred on one exposure vector (gate part 4), so gaps and levels compare directly; the source legs are shifted to the v2 seven-position mean and carry the positions each source rates

ladder_artifact.units: runs per 650 PA (per 1,277.7 fielded innings), exposure-weighted sum zero
ladder_artifact.method: same-player position-switcher network: per fielding source (Baseball-Reference runs_field, FanGraphs fld, Savant FRP) a weighted least squares of next-season fielding runs on the change in innings shares with a glove persistence and an age term, plus Savant same-season pairs; sources pooled by inverse variance; DH = 1B + the 1B rate of DH-type seasons; C by the gate's part 3 rule
